summary_rationale: Sai Life Sciences is an integrated, 100% regulated-market innovator CRDMO combining frontline US/UK discovery and process R&D hubs (Watertown/Boston, Manchester) with Indian R&D and commercial API manufacturing (Hyderabad, Bollaram, Bidar; 700 KL active Bidar base at 67% Q2 utilization + ~220-225 KL block in final quality trials, 34 commercial NCEs, 14 late-phase, 155 total pipeline programs). Serving 19 of the top 25 global pharma companies (94% of FY26 CDMO revenue from pharma; 22% consolidated biotech exposure) with 11/11 successful USFDA/PMDA inspections over 12 years and TPG's PE overhang fully exited in Aug 2025, Sai Life grew FY26 revenue to Rs 2,192 Cr (+29% YoY; H1 FY27 Rs 1,213 Cr, +17.3% YoY; Q2 +23% YoY), OPM to 29% (28% in H1 FY27), and ROCE to 19.6%, earning an India Ratings upgrade to IND AA/Stable (Nov 13 & Nov 24, 2026). Material watchpoints requiring PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health: (1) asset-liability maturity mismatch—Rs 417.9 Cr of Sep 2026 current borrowings (93.2% of ex-lease financial debt, up 5.6x in H1 FY27) bridging Rs 1,100-1,300 Cr of uncommitted FY27 capex (CWIP Rs 559.6 Cr; H1 FCF -Rs 371.2 Cr) against Ind-Ra's 1.5x adjusted net leverage downgrade trigger and CFO's open-ended debt/equity funding stance; (2) 6-9 month slippage of the second 225 KL Bidar block to early Q3 FY28, lack of commercial peptide/oligo manufacturing capacity today, H1 CFO/EBITDA dip to 56.9% (inventories +60.3% to Rs 242.1 Cr), and Rs 511.1 Cr of FY26 unbilled contract assets (23.3% of sales); and (3) two-sided US policy risk (Section 232 100% patented pharma tariffs pressuring non-exempt mid-sized biotechs + WuXi BIOSECURE court injunction ahead of Dec 18, 2026 OMB list), 97% FX billing exposure, Middle East solvent inflation, Top-10 concentration (54%), and strong domestic rivals (Anthem Biosciences at ~40%+ EBITDA margin/net cash; Hyderabad peer Aragen at Rs 2,178 Cr FY26 sales).
